SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning

SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning Evelyn D'Elia 1,2 , Weishu Zhan 2 , Giulio Turrisi 3 , Giulio Romualdi 4 , Giuseppe L'Erario 4 , Raffaello Camoriano 5,6 , Wei Pan 7 , Daniele Pucci 4 1 IIT@MIT, Italian Institute of Technology (IIT), Genoa, Italy 2 Machine Learning and Optimisation, University of Manchester, U.K. 3 Dynamic Legged Systems Laboratory, IIT, Genoa, Italy 4 Generative Bionics S.R.L, Genoa, Italy 5 DAUIN, Politecnico di Torino, Turin, Italy 6 Rehab Technologies Lab, IIT, Genoa, Italy 7 School of Engineering, Newcastle University, U.K. E. D'Elia, G. Romualdi, G. L'Erario, and D. Pucci contributed to this work while at the Artificial and Mechanical Intelligence lab, IIT, Italy. W. Pan contributed to this work while at the Machine Learning and Optimisation group, University of Manchester, U.K. 📅 Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) ## Overview We propose, SKooP, an RL-based approach which leverages Koopman model predictions and morphological symmetries to achieve faster policy convergence and better sample efficiency. This repository allows the reproduction of the paper results for the following approaches: - **PPO** (` `) - **PPOeqic** (` _emlp`) - **SKooP-NoSym-NoPred** (` _cdae_online`) - **SKooP-NoSym** (` _cdae_online_next_latent`) - **SKooP-NoPred** (` _emlp_ecdae_online`) - **SKooP** (` _emlp_ecdae_online_next_latent`) ### Supported Tasks - Stand Dance - Walk Slope - Push Door ## Installation ### Prerequisites - Python 3.8+ - CUDA 11.3 compatible GPU (optional, can run on CPU) ### Step 1: Create Conda Environment ### Step 2: Install PyTorch ### Step 3: Install Isaac Gym 1. abstract_zh: 我们提出了SKooP，一种基于强化学习的方法，利用Koopman模型预测和形态对称性来实现更快的策略收敛和更好的样本效率。该仓库允许复现以下方法的论文结果：PPO、PPOeqic、SKooP-NoSym-NoPred、SKooP-NoSym、SKooP-NoPred和SKooP。支持的任务包括站立舞蹈、斜坡行走和推门。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出SKooP方法，将Koopman算子模型预测与机器人形态对称性（等变编码）结合到强化学习策略中，利用线性动态预测加速训练。


# 一、动机

> 强化学习在腿式机器人运动任务中通常面临策略收敛慢、样本效率低的问题，现有方法未能充分利用系统动态结构和形态对称性。


# 二、方法

> 提出SKooP方法，将Koopman算子模型预测与机器人形态对称性（等变编码）结合到强化学习策略中，利用线性动态预测加速训练。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在Stand Dance、Walk Slope、Push Door三项任务中，SKooP相比PPO等基线均实现更快的策略收敛和更高的样本效率（具体数值见论文正文，摘要未给出定量结果）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与课题相关。启发：引入对称性归纳偏置和可预测的潜在动态可显著提升RL样本效率；局限：依赖Koopman模型的线性近似质量，在强非线性或复杂接触场景下可能受限。
